purpose: Teach: やみ/がかっ/もしや/ヒロシ/ひろし/ひろ/いじり/ココ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、やみで売られる偽薬の被害を医療チーム、確認しました
lines.en: Ren, we've confirmed cases of counterfeit medication damage on our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, direct opening. Steady professional tone. Measured pace—she's sharing serious information but not dramatizing it. Even breath, no flourish.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 黄色がかった皮膚症状の患者さん、貴院、診られたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has seen patients with that yellowish skin condition—have you, Doctor?
lines.style: Gentle inquiry, respectful deference. Slight lift at the end—genuinely asking, not performing. Ren leans in slightly with real interest.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、もしや感染症かと疑いを持ちました
lines.en: Yes. I suspected it might be an infection at first.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Slight pause before 'infection'—she's thinking back. Not defensive, just methodical. Professional clarity underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、ヒロシ・先生のご講演会、ご主催されるそうですね
lines.en: I heard your hospital is hosting a lecture by Professor Hiroshi—is that right, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful but engaged. Slight brightness—he's genuinely impressed by this. Careful enunciation, warm curiosity. Not fawning, just attentive.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ひろしいご縁で医師が集まりました
lines.en: Yes. Through those connections, doctors from across the region came together.
lines.style: Quiet pride, no boasting. Measured pace. She's describing something she believes in—the words land with gentle weight. Composed satisfaction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院は、ひろい地域の医療を支えていらっしゃるんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital really does support healthcare across a wide region, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Warm realization dawning. Respectful but genuine—he's putting pieces together and admiring what he sees. Thoughtful pace, no rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患部をいじり過ぎないよう医療チーム、配慮します
lines.en: Yes. We're careful to avoid over-handling the affected areas—our medical team takes that precaution seriously.
lines.style: Practical, grounded. She's moving from the bigger picture back to clinical detail. Steady, reassuring tone. The care is in the precision.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、ココアの薬効も研究なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has researched cocoa's medicinal properties too, haven't you, Doctor?
lines.style: Impressed, gentle wonder. He's piecing together layers of what this hospital does. Thoughtful, slower pace. Respect and curiosity mingled together, trailing into genuine admiration.
